_comment: The categories a song may carry. They are not decoration: a tag picks the
cover's colour (see TAG_HUE in the worker) and fills the library's
Categories list. Chips only, on purpose — free text gave the old studio
'Lo-fi', 'lofi' and 'Lo Fi' as three different shelves.
Editing this file is how the vocabulary grows. The page and the API both
read it, so they cannot disagree.
